Long-running.

profile.import_pack.description: Import a modpack into a test profile of this project (an existing profile id, or a new one). Give exactly one source: file (.mrpack or CurseForge .zip), modrinth { project, version? } or curseforge { project, file? }; without a version the newest one matching the project Minecraft version and loader is used. The pack mods are added as pinned profile mods tagged with the pack name (re-importing the same pack replaces them) and its overrides are written under profiles/<profile>/packs/. A pack copy of this project mod is left out in favour of the development build. Long-running.
